caption:
Thank you @charcuterie_chick for blessing us before our trip to @chateau_elan ! This board was a DREAM, we loved it!!!

Details:
Dry aged salami
Pepperoni 
Aged cheddar 
Jarslberg Swiss 
Brie filled with EBTB nut duo 
Goat cheese stuffed dates
Goat cheese EBTB ball 

Sweet 
Fresh Blueberries and dried blueberries 
Fresh strawberries topped with lemon zest 
Raspberry preserves
Orange preserves 

Salty & crunchy 
Cucumbers 
EBTB nut duo (cashews and almonds) 
Honey roasted mixed nuts 

Assorted crackers & sweet treats
